newsitem.title: UK: Brazil sets three-tranche five-year parallel bond.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sets three-tranche five-year parallel bond.

text.p: Brazil has issued a three-tranche parallel bond issue, joint lead managers ING Barings, Banque Paribas and Creditanstalt-Bankverein said on Monday.
All tranches have a five-year maturity and pay a 6.625 percent coupon.
They are a 2.0 billion Austrian schilling bond, a 400 million guilder issue and a 1.0 billion French franc tranche.
